surface.label: Claude Code rules
surface.readsAgentsMdNote: CLAUDE.md is read first; AGENTS.md is read only when there is no CLAUDE.md, which is why the pointer exists
surface.verified: Claude Code, "Organize rules with .claude/rules/" — recursive discovery, symlinks supported, no `paths` loads at session start
surface.note: CLAUDE.md is a separate pointer surface (see POINTERS). A rule file without frontmatter loads eagerly, which is what an always-on rule wants.

pointer.verified: Claude Code memory docs: "A symlink also works" — `ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`; Claude reads CLAUDE.md by default and AGENTS.md only as a fallback
pointer.note: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md and ignores AGENTS.md when both exist. A pointer is what makes one file answer for both without a second copy.

loader.label: Claude Code

start.why: Claude Code memory docs: CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md are discovered from the working directory and every directory above it, and all discovered files are concatenated
Claude Code memory docs: CLAUDE.local.md is loaded at each level, after CLAUDE.md from that level
Claude Code memory docs: AGENTS.md is read directly, but only when there is no CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in the working directory or above it
Claude Code memory docs: project rules under .claude/rules/ are discovered recursively and loaded at session start when unscoped
Claude Code memory docs: user-level rules in ~/.claude/rules/ load before project rules
Claude Code memory docs: skills are discovered under .claude/skills

alsoReads.why: Claude Code memory docs: auto memory loads the first 200 lines or 25 KB, whichever comes first

loader.order: filesystem root down to the working directory, CLAUDE.md before CLAUDE.local.md at each level

cap.why: Claude Code memory docs: "Claude Code loads a CLAUDE.md file of up to 4 MiB in full and skips a larger file"

imports.why: Claude Code memory docs: `@path/to/import` is expanded at launch, resolved relative to the importing file, to a maximum depth of four hops; parsing skips code spans and fenced blocks, `@` inside backticks is literal, quoted paths are not imported, and an import outside the working directory prompts for approval

loader.nested: on demand — a subdirectory CLAUDE.md loads when Claude reads, writes or edits a file in that directory

hooks.verified: Claude Code hooks docs, hook locations: project settings at .claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.local.json, user settings at ~/.claude/settings.json

agents.verified: Claude Code subagents docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents, read 2026-10-30): project subagents are markdown files with name and description frontmatter under .claude/agents/

mcp.verified: Claude Code MCP docs (read 2026-10-14): project-scoped servers live in .mcp.json in the project root; local and user scope live in ~/.claude.json

loader.verified: Claude Code memory docs (docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory, read 2026-10-14) — CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md are concatenated from every directory above the working directory, subdirectory files load on demand, `@path` imports expand to four hops, a CLAUDE.md larger than 4 MiB is skipped, and AGENTS.md is read only when no CLAUDE.md exists above the working directory
loader.note: The AGENTS.md row carries an `absent` condition because the vendor documents it as one. A repository holding both files is read by Claude Code for the CLAUDE.md alone, which is why the pointer surface exists.
